story: Discover the stunning Bearded Vulture (*Gypaetus barbatus*), a member of the diverse Accipitridae family. Native to High mountainous regions; cliffs; precipices; gorges; and open areas like grasslands and meadows, this bird faces various environmental challenges. Currently classified as Near Threatened (NT) on the IUCN Red List, the Bearded Vulture represents the delicate balance of its native region. Understanding its habitat requirements and distribution is key to effective conservation planning. This species contributes to the richness of avian diversity, and this poster offers an artistic glimpse into its world.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
